summary: list the items of a folder

sections.heading: NAME
sections.body: leva-ls - list the items of a folder

sections.heading: DESCRIPTION
sections.body:
Prints the items found in each folder, one per line.

   Output format
     With a long listing the owner and size come first.

     -a      Include items whose name starts with a dot.

     -l      Show one item per line with owner and size.

             The size is given in bytes.

sections.heading: EXIT STATUS
sections.body: Exits 0 on success and above 0 on error.
